facts.version_note: Frozen fact query exposes updated_at, not numeric version.
facts.value: Consumes a placement mode, an existing HSD_GObj, a new process-link index and priority, and an optional reference object. During active-callback deferral, the same inputs are instead copied into HSD_GObj_804CE3E4 for later execution.
facts.reason: The active GObj pointer is implicit in scheduler context rather than copied into the deferred record; unknown modes skip GObj insertion.
